portfolio.title: Selected
portfolio.subtitle: A growing showcase of production-grade concept projects — built to demonstrate exactly what we deliver for clients. Every line of code, every pixel, every interaction is real and shipping.
portfolio.note: Your project gets the same standard. Concept work today, your venue tomorrow.

projects.title: Velvet Lounge
projects.description: A luxury nightclub website concept with VIP booking, event calendar, immersive photo gallery, and rich motion design. Built end-to-end with Next.js and Tailwind.

projects.title: Nightfall Terrace
projects.description: A complete table reservation system: real-time availability, multi-step booking flow, blackout dates, and a full admin dashboard. Next.js front-end, NestJS API, PostgreSQL.

projects.title: Venue
projects.description: A full operations platform for nightlife venues — bookings, events, guest CRM with VIP tiers, floor plan, staff, and analytics. CASL-based role permissions, JWT auth, demo-mode for read-only access.

projects.title: Venue Mobile
projects.description: Staff companion app for the Venue platform. Live dashboard metrics, booking management, guest CRM with VIP tiers, role-based access — all optimized for on-the-floor mobile use.

techStack.title: Our Tech
techStack.subtitle: The tools we reach for on every project. Battle-tested, performant, and a joy to work with.

benefits.title: Fast on day one
benefits.description: Server-rendered Next.js, optimized images, and PostgreSQL out of the box. Your site loads in under a second on a phone — measured, not promised.

benefits.title: You own everything
benefits.description: Source code on your GitHub. Database on your host. Deploy keys in your hands. No vendor lock-in, no monthly SaaS fees on top.

benefits.title: Built to extend
benefits.description: Modular architecture so the next feature isn't a rewrite. Add a payment provider, a new role, or a mobile app without touching the foundation.

process.title: How We
process.subtitle: Four steps from first call to launch. Fixed price, fixed timeline, no scope-creep surprises.

steps.title: Discovery Call
steps.description: A free 30-minute call to understand your venue, your goals, and the exact problem you want solved. You leave with a clear scope and a fixed-price quote.

steps.title: Design & Prototype
steps.description: We design the key screens in Figma, walk you through them, and iterate until you're sure. You approve before any production code is written.

steps.title: Build & Review
steps.description: We build in weekly sprints with a staging URL you can check anytime. You see progress every Friday, not in a big-bang at the end.

steps.title: Launch & Handoff
steps.description: Deploy to production, hand over the source code and credentials, walk your team through anything they need. Support window starts here.

pricing.note: Every project starts with a free discovery call to scope properly and give you a firm fixed-price quote. Ranges shown are typical — final price depends on scope, integrations, and content.

content.mission: Plex is a small digital studio focused exclusively on nightlife and hospitality. We build the websites, booking systems, and mobile apps that venues actually need — not templates, not marketing fluff. Our concept projects show exactly what we can ship; your project gets the same level of care.

values.title: Hospitality-only
values.description: We don't take dental clinics or crypto landing pages. Every project we ship is for clubs, bars, restaurants, or hospitality venues.

values.title: Custom-built
values.description: No themes, no page builders. Every product is hand-written Next.js, NestJS, and React Native — designed and coded for your venue specifically.

values.title: Owned by you
values.description: You get the full source code, the database, the deploy keys. No vendor lock-in, no monthly SaaS fees, no surprises.
